scope: Current G-AnnStudio documentation and the G-Overlay Lab feature slice

architecture_recommendation.rationale: Moderate Tauri + React desktop codebase, a mature feature slice, privacy/security boundaries, and no evidence that AI/ML lifecycle documentation is the primary product concern.

not_recommended_yet.reason: AI-assisted media tooling is present, but no owned model lifecycle, dataset, or training pipeline was found in this package.

findings.title: Content taxonomy lacks document control metadata
findings.details: docs/content-taxonomy.md has a proposal status in prose but lacks version, author, created/updated timestamps, and a version-history table.
findings.action: Add the standard YAML metadata and changelog when the proposal is next revised.

findings.title: Hosted cloud evidence remains an intentional gate
findings.details: GOE-005 now has an approved threat model/RLS contract, local projection helper, migration, and tests. Hosted migration, cleanup retention, and signed-URL live evidence remain intentionally outside local proof.
findings.action: Keep the cloud control disabled for production until hosted migration and operational evidence are approved.

findings.title: No model-card appendix is present
findings.details: The selected 3-Layer + Appendix structure does not include Appendix C because no owned model lifecycle, dataset, or training pipeline was found in this package.
findings.action: Add Appendix C only if G-AnnStudio begins to ship or operate a model lifecycle.

findings.title: Cross-repo graph paths use explicit repo prefixes
findings.details: Cross-repo graph nodes now use the explicit gmaiden: prefix, so the resolver can distinguish sibling-repository files from missing paths.
findings.action: Keep the explicit repo-prefix convention for future cross-repository nodes.

findings.title: Two new Overlay Lab modules carry no @req annotations
findings.details: lib/labView.ts and components/OverlayModulePreview.tsx entered the graph this session via the import graph, not via annotations. Both are inside the GOE scope; neighbouring files (OverlayLab, overlayLayout) do carry @req/@spec headers.
findings.action: Add @req/@spec headers so the edges come from declared intent rather than inference.

passes.details: The approved 3-Layer + Appendix core now has a docs index, PRD-SDD, architecture, contribution guide, frontend design system, API index, threat model, and appendices A, B, D, E, and F.
Appendix F defines the shared G-AnnStudio and G-Maiden terminology used by the scoped documents.

Task 3 timing-consistency refresh confirms the corrected Figma editor specification, verification records, traceability matrix, and scanned implementation agree on optional startMs/endMs timing, future keyframes, SVG rasterization before runtime handoff, pure unwired preflight, and the distinction between the 0.5-3.5 second authored-animation ceiling, local 3.5-second previews, and G-Maiden's 4.0-second show plus 0.8-second exit lifecycle. The BannerEditor test provides local-preview evidence only; GOE-004 remains partial and full runtime HUD acceptance remains open.
22 scanned documents: zero broken file://, relative, wiki, or explicit sibling-repository links.

GOE-005 refresh: docs/.doc-graph.json parses; its declared counts match contents (56 nodes / 97 edges), file-backed SHA-256 prefixes match the current scoped documents and code, explicit gmaiden: paths identify sibling-repository files, and annotations trace the cloud projection plus pgTAP migration tests. GOE-003 and GOE-005 remain partial with live evidence gates.

Vitest passes 26 tests across BannerProject, store history, BannerEditor jsdom behavior, motion export preflight, and private cloud projection/validation. G-Maiden pgTAP assertions are present but not runnable locally without Supabase CLI/Docker.
TypeScript noEmit and the Vite production build pass; the bundle-size notice remains non-blocking.
The RWANG Mellum alignment gate found no conflicts between BannerEditor component-test behavior and the Figma editor specification.
